summary: Four reusable facts are proved inline (the mass-shell rigidity step, the zero-velocity spatial part, the boost pairing identity, and a general HasDerivWithinAt comp-neg lemma), and the spatial-part reasoning is done four times by pushing EuclideanSpace equations through the raw `⇑` coercion instead of `spatialPart_apply_eq_toCoord` or a single linearity lemma.
